purpose: HOST01 for puae6.wbx: what the objects of the engine, the portable host port, the bridge and the guest adapter import from libc and from the C++ runtime. The deterministic profile has no clock, file, process, thread, network or dynamic loading, so none of those may appear; tools/build_waterbox.py audit_imports fails the build on any name outside this list. Measured with llvm-nm on the 55 objects of the first link: 37 names.

notes.exceptions: Only build/upstream/newcpu.cpp throws and catches (the 68000 core models its exceptions with C++ exceptions). Unwinding inside Waterbox has to be shown to work by a guest that takes one: T19b/T19c.
notes.math: sinf, cosf and powf are Paula's filter math (audio_math.cpp). Their results come from the musl and compiler-rt of the pinned sysroot, not from the host libm; T19c compares the PCM with headless.
